summary.text: Tina Orwall is a Democratic member of the Washington State Senate from District 33, which she has represented since December 11, 2024, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She served in the Washington House of Representatives from 2009 to 2024 and is a grant writer by profession.

paragraphs.text: Orwall earned a B.S. in psychology and an M.A. in social work administration from the University of Washington.
Her career experience includes working as a grant writer and as the Washington State Taking Healthcare Home Coordinator in the City of Seattle, Office of Housing.
She has served as an elected Precinct Committee Officer and as former chair of the 33rd Legislative District.
Orwall represented House District 33-Position 1 from 2009 to 2024, when Edwin Obras (D) succeeded her, and she took the Senate seat held by Karen Keiser (D).
In the 2023-2024 session she served on the Capital Budget, Health Care and Wellness, Commerce & Gaming and House Rules committees and the Joint Veterans' and Military Affairs Committee.
No other candidate is listed for the November ballot.
